en.t: The dance music Spring Warbler's Song was performed.

units.source_text: 朱雀院听了，回想当年桐壶帝举行花宴时的情景，

en.t: Suzaku-in listened and recalled the scene when Emperor Kiritsubo had once held the Flower Banquet,

units.source_text: 慨然说道：“那时的盛况，恐难再得了！”

en.t: and said with deep feeling, "Such splendor as we had then will probably never be seen again!"

units.source_text: 源氏也历历回思当日之事。

en.t: Genji too vividly remembered the events of that day.

units.source_text: 舞曲奏毕之后，源氏向朱雀院敬酒，献诗云：

en.t: After the music had ended, Genji offered wine to Suzaku-in and presented this poem:
